title: Playwright Booking Smoke Path
summary: Engineering showcase: automated browser smoke — pick service → confirm — so bz.a H5 booking paths stay repeatable for demos and regression, not a separate product.
problem: Live H5 demos drift after deploys. Without a short automated path, showcase CTAs and bid videos can break silently between recordings.
solution:
Portfolio-side automation practice aligned with the booking demos: a Playwright smoke script walks the guest path (select service → slot → confirmation) against the bz.a H5 demo. Outcome is pass/fail signal and optional CI screenshots — not a hosted video URL on this case page. Same evidence chain as「展示站 CTA → H5 live demo」; validates the path before you record a 60s clip.

No client attribution; exercises the public demo environment only.

zh.title: Playwright 预约冒烟路径
zh.summary: 工程展示：浏览器自动化冒烟——选服务 → 确认——让 bz.a H5 预约路径在演示与回归中可重复，非独立产品。
zh.problem: H5 上线后界面容易悄悄变样。没有一条短自动化路径，展示站 CTA 和投标录屏可能在两次录制之间已经坏了。
zh.solution:
与预约 demo 同一条证据链的作品集自动化实践：Playwright 冒烟脚本走访客路径（选服务 → 时段 → 确认），目标为 bz.a H5 演示环境。产出是通过/失败信号与可选 CI 截图——本案例页不提供虚构的视频链接。与「展示站 CTA → H5」一致，录 60 秒前先验路径。

不挂靠客户；仅针对公开 demo 环境。
